newsitem.title: USA: Phillips makes key management changes.
newsitem.headline: Phillips makes key management changes.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said Wednesday that it has approved a number of key management changes.
Among the new appointments, Jim Gallogly was named to head the plastics division and Jim Bowles head of North American production.
Other new managers appointed are David Bairrington as vice president of branded marketing, Jacqueline Wagner as controller and John Carrig as treasurer.

Phillips said David Casselberry, currently vice president of plastics, is named to a new position of manager of strategic transactions "in which he will help support the company's ambitious growth initiatives."
Bowles moves from head of Phillips Ekofisk operating unit in Norway, while Gallogly currently is head of North American production.
Wagner takes over from Leonard Francis who is retiring early.
